credit.notes: Customer care 1800 10 888 ('For Accounts, Credit Cards, Loans, and Other banking services') is available 24x7. Block paths per the bank's credit-card FAQ: mobile app → 'Manage Cards' → 'Block Card'; internet banking → 'Credit Cards' section → 'Block Card'; the 24x7 helpline; or SMS 'CCBLOCK1234' to 5676732 (1234 = last 4 digits of the card). Self-service: 'Block your Credit Card' service request at idfcfirst.bank.in/service-request?sr=ccb. If the card is lost or stolen, block it immediately via mobile banking or customer care; after blocking, report unauthorized transactions to banker@idfcfirstbank.com or 180010888. Overseas (NRI customer care, toll-free unless noted): USA 18337039805, Canada 18337039811, UK 448000 478 414, UAE 8000 187 922, Singapore 800 101 4006, Australia 1800314585; full table on the bank's customer-care page. WhatsApp banking: say 'Hi' on 9555 555 555.

debit.notes: Customer care 1800 10 888 is toll-free and available 24/7 ('Call us on 1800 10 888 — We are available 24/7 for you'). Permanent block/hotlist per the bank's debit-card FAQ: in the mobile banking app go to Accounts → Cards tab, choose the card, select 'Permanently Block'; or visit the nearest branch; or call 1800 10 888. Self-service: the 'Block your Debit Card' tile on the customer-care pages opens idfcfirst.bank.in/customer-care-sr/debit-card-block. Lost card: block permanently via the Mobile Banking app or customer support 180010888; a replacement debit card can be requested at the time of blocking or later. After blocking, report unauthorized transactions to banker@idfcfirstbank.com or 180010888. No SMS block keyword is published for debit cards. Overseas (NRI customer care, toll-free unless noted): USA 18337039805, Canada 18337039811, UK 448000 478 414, UAE 8000 187 922, Singapore 800 101 4006, Australia 1800314585; full table on the bank's customer-care page. WhatsApp banking: say 'Hi' on 9555 555 555.

upi.notes: No in-app UPI lock menu path, netbanking UPI manage path, SMS keyword, or WhatsApp UPI-block service is published on the bank's own pages. UPI T&C (terms-and-conditions/upi-solutions): 'The user has to immediately bring it to the notice of IDFC FIRST Bank in case he/she suspects that his / her Mobile number is / has been allotted/ used by another person and/or notices unauthorized transactions in his / her accounts and make sure that the facility is deregistered for his / her mobile no.'; 'Entering the wrong mPIN thrice will block the UPI facility where the linked account belongs to IDFC FIRST bank'; registration is auto-suspended if the facility has not been accessed for 180 days or more. Emergency path: call customer care 1800 10 888 (24x7, 'For Accounts, Credit Cards, Loans, and Other banking services') to have the UPI facility deregistered, or file under 'Report any UNAUTH Transaction' -> 'Steps to Report Unauthorised transaction -> Click here' (/customer-care-sr/raise-a-request). androidApp/iosApp resolved 2026-11-01 by following the bank's own download link idfcnetbanking.onelink.me/p1bD/1jq39swv published in the site footer.
